name: Demon Fall Canyon
summary: Demon Fall Canyon bears the scars of the battle that freed the orcs from the blood curse. Here, Thrall and Grommash Hellscream faced Mannoroth in southern Ashenvale.

sections.title: The Fall of Mannoroth
sections.body: In southern Ashenvale, the canyon lies near Felfire Hill and Demon Fall Ridge, its land scarred by the Third War. Warchief Thrall and chieftain Grommash Hellscream tracked the pit lord Mannoroth here to break his hold over the Horde. Mannoroth struck Thrall down, and Grom seized the chance to drive his axe, Gorehowl, into the demon’s chest. The infernal blast shattered Mannoroth and killed Grom. With the pit lord’s death, the orcs were free of their lingering demonic servitude.

sections.title: A Sacred Yet Dangerous Chasm
sections.body: The Horde named the canyon for Grom’s final stand and raised a monument nearby to honor his redemption. Mannoroth’s death unleashed demonic power that tainted the surrounding land. Fel magic still saturates the canyon, where lesser demons roam. Pilgrims who come to this hallowed ground face danger at every turn.

faq.q: Why is this place called Demon Fall Canyon?
aliases: how did it get its name
faq.answer: The Horde named the canyon for the fall of Mannoroth, slain here by Grommash Hellscream.

faq.q: What happened between Grom and Mannoroth here?
faq.answer: Thrall and Grom confronted Mannoroth together. The pit lord knocked Thrall unconscious, but Grom struck a lethal blow with his axe. Mannoroth’s blast of demonic fire fatally wounded Grom, whose dying act freed his people from the blood curse.

faq.q: Why are there still demons roaming the canyon?
faq.answer: Mannoroth’s death unleashed a tremendous blast of demonic energy that permanently corrupted the canyon floor. Lingering fel corruption still attracts and harbors lesser demons.
A monument honoring Grom Hellscream stands near Demon Fall Canyon, where Horde pilgrims pay tribute to the warrior who freed their people.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you stand on sacred ground where Grommash Hellscream made his ultimate sacrifice and broke the Burning Legion’s blood curse.
As an orc, you owe your spiritual and physical freedom to the battle in this canyon, where Grom gave his life to end your demonic bondage.
